title: Otter PageSpec
description: The machine contract for a generated page. Closed template enum, closed section enum, closed assetRole enum, closed motion object, additionalProperties:false everywhere. Structural rules JSON Schema cannot express live in compatibility/graph.json and are enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py — a PageSpec is only valid if it passes BOTH.

route.description: A real route path. /sign-up and /welcome are forbidden — removed on purpose (NO_REMOVED_ROUTES).

template.description: Closed enum of the 11 real page shapes. 'sign-up' and 'welcome' are deliberately absent.

designSystem.description: auth is the app host (Vite + React + Mantine), a separate design system from the Webflow marketing site.

theme.description: The site has exactly one theme per design system. There is no dark mode and no theme switcher.

section.description: Closed enum of the 28 real section types.

variant.description: Must be one of the section's declared variants, and must match the template's pinned variant where it pins one.

motion.description: CLOSED to the real, evidence-grounded motion fields actually in use on this site. additionalProperties is false on purpose: leaving it open lets a generated PageSpec smuggle in an invented field and still validate. There is deliberately NO stagger field — there is no stagger anywhere on the site.

pattern.description: Must also be one of the declaring section's own allowedPatterns (MOTION_PATTERN_CLOSED).

reducedMotionFallback.description: Required. Must equal the section contract's declared fallback.

durationMs.description: The only durations measured on this site.

delayMs.description: The only delays measured on this site.

easing.description: ease.outQuart = cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1). The site uses no other curve.

triggerOffsetPercentOfViewport.description: The one measured scroll-reveal trigger offset.

replaysOnSwitch.description: true only for the tabs card's 500ms slideInFromBottom, which replays on each switch.

asymmetricTiming.description: true only for the <=991px tabs accordion (100ms delay then 300ms on open, no delay on close).

loadMore.note: A single 'Load more' pill, rendered for visual fidelity and DELIBERATELY INERT. The original is Finsweet CMS Load v1 pointed at page 2; this clone only holds the 10 real page-1 posts, so there is nothing to load and no extra posts are fabricated to give it something to reveal. It is an <a> with no href, role="button", aria-disabled="true" and a preventDefault click, inside a div[role=navigation][aria-label="List"]. Its CSS pins cursor:pointer so it looks identical to the original's real anchor while still doing nothing. A generated instance must not wire it to real pagination. There is no category filter, no tab bar and no search on this page.

items.description: Per-section content contracts live HERE, on the node item, not on the root object. They are if/then branches keyed on this node's own `section` value; attaching them to the root would make every `if` require a `section` property the root does not have, silently disabling all 28 content contracts.

x-pinnedAssetPolicies.note: These roles are PINNED to a specific policy value, not merely constrained to the enum. verify_all.py enforces each pinned pairing exactly, and schema/tests/adversarial_test.py proves a mutation to a DIFFERENT-BUT-VALID enum member is rejected. Membership-in-a-closed-set is a weaker claim than 'this role must have this value', and these four roles carry real legal weight.
